bl-append-run-unlocked.cls: unlocked read-modify-write of a shared state file
bl-append-run-unlocked.mechanism: Two run-close paths each read state.json, append their row and write_text the whole file with no lock, so the last writer drops the other run; write_text truncates first, so a concurrent reader can see invalid JSON, map it to {} and the next save wipes every run.

bl-state-finalize-unlocked.mechanism: annotate_if_incomplete reads state.json and atomically replaces it without taking the LockedFile that append_run and the other state.json writers hold, so a runs[] row or execution update written between its read and replace is silently reverted.
